title: Trait Wars
description: Compare soft skill profiles in head-to-head battles. Each card reveals a leader or scenario — pick the winning attribute to collect their card!
cultural_context: Indian professional context — startup founders, NGO leaders, corporate managers, community organizers.
learning_objectives: Recognize how different soft skills create value in different situations
Understand your natural leadership style and dominant trait
Learn from Indian professional archetypes across sectors
Develop awareness of how attribute choices reveal personality patterns

deck.name: The Empathist
deck.story: Asha grew up listening. Before any meeting, she maps every stakeholder's concerns. Her teams follow her not from authority, but from trust.
deck.image_prompt: compassionate Indian woman community organizer warm smile listening group meeting
deck.learning_note: High empathy correlates with stronger team trust, lower conflict, and better retention in organizations.

deck.name: The Strategist
deck.story: Rohan always has 3 moves planned ahead. He sees patterns others miss and builds coalitions before the meeting starts.
deck.image_prompt: analytical Indian man consultant chessboard strategy whiteboard office
deck.learning_note: Strategic thinking involves planning ahead, systems awareness, and stakeholder mapping.

deck.name: The Innovator
deck.story: Priya sees constraints as creative challenges. Her pitch decks break convention and her products change behaviour.
deck.image_prompt: creative Indian woman startup founder colorful office brainstorming innovation
deck.learning_note: Creative leadership drives innovation but benefits from strategic grounding to turn ideas into impact.

deck.name: The Resilient
deck.story: Vikram has managed 3 startup failures and still shows up. His team trusts him because he never panics — even when the server's down.
deck.image_prompt: calm Indian man crisis manager steady composed emergency situation office
deck.learning_note: Resilience is built through prior adversity, strong support networks, and self-awareness practices.

deck.name: The Risk-Taker
deck.story: Anita bets big on founders others pass on. Her contrarian approach has produced 4 unicorns — and 12 spectacular failures.
deck.image_prompt: bold Indian woman investor confident pitch room decision moment
deck.learning_note: Risk tolerance isn't recklessness — it's calculated acceptance of uncertainty with a strong recovery plan.

deck.name: The Communicator
deck.story: Deepak can translate complex engineering concepts into 10-second soundbites. His words move crowds and calm boardrooms.
deck.image_prompt: confident Indian man speaker stage audience microphone engaging presentation
deck.learning_note: Effective communication adapts message to audience — not just what you say, but how you say it.

deck.name: The Builder
deck.story: Kavya builds systems that scale. She plans for failure from day one and documents obsessively so anyone can pick up where she left off.
deck.image_prompt: focused Indian woman engineer laptop code architecture diagram whiteboard
deck.learning_note: Long-term thinking involves designing systems with future users and maintainers in mind.

deck.name: The Peacemaker
deck.story: Sunita de-escalates before others even see the conflict forming. She reframes disagreement as shared problem-solving.
deck.image_prompt: calm Indian woman mediator two parties negotiation table peace resolution
deck.learning_note: Conflict mediation requires active listening, reframing, and emotional regulation techniques.

deck.name: The Visionary
deck.story: Arjun saw the future of rural India 10 years before others did. He's been building toward it ever since — one village at a time.
deck.image_prompt: visionary Indian man rural India map plan inspiration future community
deck.learning_note: Visionaries combine creativity with execution discipline — ideas only matter if they actually land.

deck.name: The Collaborator
deck.story: Meera has built coalitions across 14 states by making every partner feel like the co-author, not a vendor.
deck.image_prompt: inclusive Indian woman NGO director group circle collaboration warmth smiling
deck.learning_note: Collaborative leadership distributes ownership and builds sustainable coalitions across diverse groups.

deck.name: The Analyst
deck.story: Rahul lets the numbers lead, but he never forgets to ask why the numbers matter. His reports change decisions, not just inform them.
deck.image_prompt: Indian man data analyst charts insight discovery laptop warm office glow
deck.learning_note: Analytical thinking is enhanced by empathy — data without context misses the human truth behind numbers.

deck.name: The Disruptor
deck.story: Pooja questions every process. Her 'why do we do it this way?' leads teams to breakthrough redesigns.
deck.image_prompt: energetic Indian woman product manager whiteboard question disruption startup office
deck.learning_note: Disruption requires courage to challenge norms while still bringing your people along with you.

deck.name: The Mentor
deck.story: Suresh has coached 200 students to leadership roles. He remembers every name, every struggle, and every breakthrough.
deck.image_prompt: wise Indian man mentor teacher classroom guiding student warm smile wisdom
deck.learning_note: Great mentors ask before they advise — the right question opens more doors than the best answer.

deck.name: The Negotiator
deck.story: Neha enters every deal knowing 3 possible outcomes. She never leaves without agreement — even if it's on what to disagree about.
deck.image_prompt: confident Indian woman deal boardroom negotiation signed agreement success
deck.learning_note: Negotiation succeeds when you understand the other side's constraints as well as your own.

deck.name: The Executor
deck.story: Kartik turns vision into roadmaps and roadmaps into reality. His checklists are legendary — so is his ability to unblock teams.
deck.image_prompt: disciplined Indian man operations checklist task management organized office deadline
deck.learning_note: Execution discipline separates vision from impact — the world is full of unfinished great ideas.

trait_profiles.label: Empathic Leader
trait_profiles.description: You prioritize human connection and trust. Your teams follow you because they feel genuinely seen and heard. You build relationships before transactions.
trait_profiles.strength: Creating psychological safety and deep trust

trait_profiles.label: Systems Thinker
trait_profiles.description: You see 3 moves ahead. You excel at planning, anticipating second-order effects, and creating leverage from complexity.
trait_profiles.growth_area: Balance analysis with empathy for people impact

trait_profiles.label: Creative Catalyst
trait_profiles.description: You break conventional thinking and inspire original solutions. Your ideas challenge assumptions and open new possibilities.
trait_profiles.strength: Generating breakthrough ideas in constrained situations
trait_profiles.growth_area: Channel creativity into structured execution plans

trait_profiles.label: Unshakeable
trait_profiles.description: Setbacks energize you. You build systems and teams designed to recover. Your steadiness under pressure is your greatest asset.
trait_profiles.strength: Maintaining composure and direction in crises
trait_profiles.growth_area: Use resilience as a foundation — add proactive risk thinking

trait_profiles.label: Bold Decider
trait_profiles.description: You move fast and accept uncertainty. Your bias for action creates momentum and galvanizes teams to commit.
trait_profiles.growth_area: Slow down to gather more empathy signals before deciding

trait_profiles.label: Natural Leader
trait_profiles.description: People align behind your direction. You balance authority with inclusion, ensuring everyone feels part of the mission.
trait_profiles.strength: Rallying diverse people around a shared goal
trait_profiles.growth_area: Build deeper analytical frameworks to support your vision

glossary_terms.definition: Best Alternative To a Negotiated Agreement — your fallback plan if talks break down.
glossary_terms.example: If the salary offer is too low, your BATNA is another job offer on the table.

glossary_terms.definition: Interpersonal abilities like communication, empathy, and adaptability that apply across all professions.
glossary_terms.example: Unlike coding or accounting, soft skills determine how well you work with others.

glossary_terms.definition: Emotional Intelligence — the ability to perceive, understand, manage, and use emotions effectively.
glossary_terms.example: High EQ leaders de-escalate conflict before it erupts and inspire trust through self-awareness.

glossary_terms.definition: The belief that abilities can be developed through dedication and hard work.
glossary_terms.example: Instead of 'I'm not good at this', a growth mindset says 'I'm not good at this yet'.

achievements.name: Card Collector
achievements.description: Win 10+ cards in a single game

achievements.name: Renaissance Leader
achievements.description: Use all 6 attributes in a single game

coaching_moment: Recognize how different soft skills create value in different situations. Understand your natural leadership style and dominant trait.
reflection_prompt: What's one thing you'll take from this game into a real-world situation this week?
